metaDesc: testimonials, Quantum Healing Hypnosis Technique is a hypnosis (hypnotherapy) method developed by the late Dolores Cannon, based in Canungra, Gold Coast, QLD.

blocks.text: Marina's hypnotherapy sessions have been truly life-changing, helping me overcome deep-seated fears and find inner peace.
highly recommend Marina for hypnotherapy. She is friendly and professional and has the ability to hold a safe, relaxing and positive space.

My intention was to explore my past, present and future lifetimes. During my session I journeyed through multiple timelines and was excited to discover a common theme occurring throughout. I came out of it with valuable insights into my way of being, my traits and interests, as well as my soul's purpose in this current lifetime.
Thank you so much Marina I'm looking forward to exploring more with you

My first ever hypnotherapy session and it was great. I learnt a lot about myself and have been living with intermittent pain in my shoulder from osteoarthritis for years, and have not had any pain for the months since my session! The mind is powerful but it needs guidance. Thank you Marina, I’m coming back to explore some more

I highly recommend Marina and her healing services. I’ve had hypnotherapy before and for someone at the start of their career, Marina was amazing. She held a safe space for me to openly talk about my blocks and several pressing issues which she guided me through comfortably and with ease. I woke feeling refreshed and lighter. I will definitely be seeing Marina again and would be happy to recommend her and her services to anyone wanting to shift deep subconscious conditionings and blocks. Thank you
